# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering and memory refinements**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves Android rendering cadence and reduces allocation overhead in image, stream, and text-shaping paths. Android texture rendering now follows display refresh, while managed pixel copies, HarfBuzz text shaping, feature-string decoding, and front-buffered streams avoid unnecessary retained memory or allocations.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture rendering follows display refresh** — Texture-backed rendering on Android is synchronized with the display refresh cadence for smoother presentation. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Image pixel copies use less managed overhead** — Managed image pixel-copy operations avoid unnecessary work, reducing overhead when applications transfer pixel data. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **Text-shaping allocations reduced** — HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding reuses a pooled buffer, and feature-string decoding avoids an unnecessary native allocation. ([#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Front-buffered streams no longer retain data unnecessarily** — Front-buffered streams release retained data correctly, reducing memory retention during stream-based decoding and processing. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
